title: Conservation group calls for moratorium on AI data centers on US public lands
source_used: Reuters lede on TradingView (Reuters feed) and Reuters' own US domestic news summary on Devdiscourse; the Reuters page (pool link) returned HTTP 401
key_facts: The Wilderness Society, a US conservation group, called on Monday 5 Oct 2026 for a moratorium on artificial intelligence data centers on federal lands.
It cited concerns over water use, electricity demand, wildlife habitat and public access.
The call comes as the Trump administration is considering permits for several data center developments on lands managed by the Bureau of Land Management, according to federal land records.
Reuters notes that President Donald Trump has sought to expand a range of industries on public lands, including mining and oil and gas.
Only the opening paragraphs of the Reuters story were available; the group's detailed demands and any official response were not.
